data.gender_notes: Ibraaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-r-z' meaning 'to be strong'. Ibraaz signifies one who is strong and generous, providing for others and being gentle in his actions. The name Ibraaz carries the meaning “Gentle, generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibraaz usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies divine power, protection and strength
data.etymology: Ibraaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibraaz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ibraaz is of Arabic origin, widely used in the Muslim world, and is considered to be a noble and respected name. When someone introduces themselves with this name, it can create an impression of strength, courage, and generosity, qualities that are deeply valued in Islamic culture. It can also serve as a reminder of the spiritual qualities that one should strive to embody in their daily life.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the name Ibraaz holds spiritual significance as it is associated with Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), one of the most revered figures in Islamic history. He was known for his unwavering faith in God, his ability to overcome hardships, and his generosity towards his family and community. By bearing this name, one is reminded of these spiritual qualities and is encouraged to strive towards emulating them in their own life. Additionally, the name Ibraaz can be seen as a reminder of God's promise to strengthen and support His believers in times of need.
